QR code to connect to the hotspot

Opens the device\'s real Wi-Fi hotspot settings — some vendors hide this screen from the normal Settings menu entirely (as on this Kyocera device), so this shortcut may be the only way to reach it. Requires one manual tap to turn it on/off — Android does not allow apps to do this automatically without root.
Could not find the Wi-Fi hotspot settings on this device.

Starts the real Wi-Fi hotspot (with Internet sharing) directly via root, no manual tap needed. EXPERIMENTAL: requires a rooted device and has not been tested on real hardware, since the developer\'s own device is not rooted.
Root access not available (su not found, or access denied).
